Questions

Do I need a new phone number?

No. Keep your number and forward calls to the AI number we set up for you, or use the new number directly.

What if the AI cannot answer a question?

It answers only from the business information you give it. When it does not know, it takes a message, creates a task and can transfer the caller to your team.

Which calendars work?

Google Calendar and Microsoft Outlook. The AI only offers times you are free and adds a Meet or Teams link when you want one.

Can I use just the CRM?

Yes. The CRM only plan is $49/month with leads, clients, quotes, invoices, tasks and finance, without the AI receptionist.

What happens if I go over my minutes?

Nothing stops. Extra minutes, chats and messages are billed at the low rates shown on the pricing page.

Can I cancel?

Yes, at any time. You keep access for 14 days, and you can export all your data whenever you like.

Calendar access

When a business connects Google Calendar or Outlook, H2M AI CRM reads only free/busy times and creates, updates or removes the appointment events it books. It does not read other events or use calendar data for advertising or AI training. See our Privacy Policy.
